title: Usage & Limits
subtitle: use against the package, newest reading
unassignedOne: 1 website has no owner, so its use is not counted here. Give it an owner from the website's Manage page.
unassignedMany: {count} websites have no owner, so their use is not counted here. Give them an owner from the website's Manage page.
empty: No account has a website or a package yet.
footnote: Disk is measured hourly and bandwidth every 15 minutes for every account with a website; CPU and memory every five minutes, only when the package limits them. A notice goes to the account at 80% and at 100% of a limit, once until use falls back.

history.noReadings: No readings in the last seven days.
history.note: Hourly averages over seven days. The dashed line is the package limit.
